data_fields.name: save_gate_override
data_fields.donor_constant: per-save key SceneEntraceCondition_<zoneId>, falls back to table value

best_idea: One data table of zones where each zone has an entry gate (open, closed, or skill-gated) that a save can override, and exits named by trigger, so the same exit lists drive transitions, signage and the overworld map.
decision_why: Zones as data fits our ruling, so take the zone table, the exit-by-trigger-name list and the per-save gate override; the donor's client-side gate and string lookups do not fit, so the gate moves to the server and the lookup becomes an indexed typed map with fail-closed unknowns.
acceptance: A server test asserts that an entry request to a gate-1 zone is refused for a save with no override, is accepted after the override is set, and that an exit name missing from the zone's list returns no destination without crashing.
